profile.headline: Software Engineer at Medical Informatics Corporation

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
As a Full Stack Software Engineer at Medical Informatics Corp., I contribute to the design, architecture, and development of a wide array of interactive, web-based applications. My role involves wearing multiple hats and leading various aspects of the development process, including:

Full Stack Development: Building and maintaining both front-end (React) and back-end (JavaScript, PostgreSQL) components, with a strong emphasis on clean, efficient code and best practices.
Project Leadership: Prioritizing tasks, leading team demos, and effectively communicating project progress to stakeholders. This includes leading meetings for internal projects, presenting updates, and showcasing upcoming plans.
Quality Assurance & Code Review: Ensuring rigorous testing of new and existing applications to maintain high software standards and identifying areas for potential improvement.
Version Control: Utilizing Git for efficient version control and collaboration.
Database Management: Proficient in using PostgreSQL for backend data storage and retrieval, as well as managing API calls for seamless integration.
Dashboard Implementation: Successfully developed a functional analytics dashboard for internal use, optimizing data visualization and user experience.
Team Collaboration: Acting as scrum master periodically, leading stand-up meetings, and ensuring alignment across the development team.
Client & Stakeholder Communication: Maintaining clear and open lines of communication to establish and update maintenance procedures for software systems.
This role showcases my versatility as an engineer who not only codes but also takes initiative in task management, project leadership, and fostering team cohesion.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
- Researching and identify needed solutions, determine implementation designs, providing guidance
- Manage small to medium sized complex projects by reviewing requirements and turning them into technical solutions
- Recommend modifications to processes and procedures, best practice contributions, and architecture
Software development of variety projects ranging from industry-wide services to client-specific reports resulting in EDI (Electronic Data Interchange) and other interfacing technologies.
- Collaborate with team of developers, production support, and customer support on software projects, creating resolutions on issues and developing solutions.
- Perform the quality assurance and integration testing for projects after development is completed and before projects are deployed
- Troubleshoot business and production issues by gathering information, conducting root cause analysis to reduce issues.

positions.title: Data Migration Analyst & Jr. PHP Programmer
positions.description:
- Wrote PHP and Python scripts to create a seamless ETL process from client’s previous ERP system to OpenGov’s
- Worked jointly with the ERP Migration Business Analyst to be the primary technical point of contact for new customers deploying STW ERP, or those expanding to implement additional functionality.
- Implemented the analysis created by the Business Analyst to seamlessly migrate the existing customer data to the STW ERP data structures.
- Understood customer pain points and partner with cross-functional teams to simplify, enhance and automate existing processes that will improve customer workflow.
- Worked closely with the ERP Migration Business Analyst, Project Management, Customer Success Management, and Integration  management teams to facilitate and drive a consistent customer experience and ensure successful projects and training for new customers.
- Leveraged and continually developed best practices for each data environment and customer vertically to assist in future implementation efficiencies.

positions.title: Student Lab Assitant
positions.description:
•	Created installation scripts in BASH for machines. The scripts created module files for various compilers and languages which were made available to all users on the campus Linux servers
•	Maintain healthy lab environments across the Engineering and Computer Science buildings
•	Troubleshoot technology issues for students, classroom, and faculty
•	Keep department inventory, maintain and organize work environments
•	Designed and Developed an interactive way-finding system for the department

positions.title: Freelance Photographer
positions.description:
•	Learned how to operate a DSLR & CSLR camera 
•	Obtained time management skills when figuring out when and where to set up photography sessions
•	Shot 30 paid photography sessions, from studio level portraits to the 2014 Miss Green and Gold Beauty Pageant  
•	Managed my own budget
